title: Stock Gains Shrink; China Markets Rise On Easing Tensions With U.S. - Investor's Business Daily
text:

Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin on Sunday said the U.S. trade war with China was "on hold." Mnuchin said the two sides agreed on a framework. Further details were lacking, but the market apparently decided that a trade war was now less likely.
In the 30-component Dow, 18 stocks rose at least 1%. Volume was running more than 100% higher for Caterpillar ( CAT ), Boeing ( BA ) and General Electric ( GE ). The three stocks rose 2.5%, 3% and 3% respectively.
Caterpillar, Boeing and GE each have significant China exposure.
Apple ( AAPL ) and the FANG stocks also rose but then faded in midday trade. Apple held a 0.7% gain after being up 1.6%; Facebook ( FB ) was up 0.3%; Amazon.com ( AMZN ), 0.3%; Netflix ( NFLX ), 1%; and Alphabet ( GOOGL ), 1%. Volume, though, was quiet for each of the stocks. Transportation Stocks Rise
Among IBD's 197 industry groups, transportation equipment did well, jumping 2.5%. Wabtec ( WAB ) rose 3.5% in torrid volume as GE confirmed it will merge its transportation unit with Wabtec. GE and its shareholders will own 50.1% of the combined company.
Greenbrier Companies ( GBX ), another transportation play, added more than 3%. The small-cap stock is on track for a fourth consecutive daily gain.
